newsitem.title: USA: Tristar lender will not renew agreement.
newsitem.headline: Tristar lender will not renew agreement.

text.p: Tristar Corp said on Tuesday it has been advised by its current lender that due to a change in its internal lending strategies it will not renew the existing agreement that expires in July 1997.
Tristar said it is having ongoing discussions with potential new lenders to support both current and future cash requirements.
Tristar on Tuesday reported a second-quarter loss of $0.04 per share, compared to a loss of $0.15 per share for the same period a year ago.
